mainEntity.name: How much does a minicab from Lewisham SE13 to Heathrow Airport cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard saloon from Lewisham SE13 to Heathrow is fixed at £63, confirmed at the time of booking and unchanged regardless of traffic on the South Circular or along the A3 and A316 on the day. Every vehicle class from saloon through to eight-seat MPV is displayed with its complete fare before you confirm, so the price shown at booking is the price charged when you arrive at the terminal.

mainEntity.name: Lewisham has DLR and National Rail — can either get me to Heathrow?

acceptedAnswer.text: The DLR from Lewisham runs north to Bank in the City of London but has no Heathrow connection. National Rail services from Lewisham and Hither Green stations run to London Bridge, Charing Cross, and Cannon Street, none of which connect directly to Heathrow. Passengers from SE13 must travel by rail to London Bridge or Charing Cross, then connect to the Jubilee line to Green Park, change to the Piccadilly line westbound, and complete the full 40 to 45 minute Piccadilly ride. Door-to-terminal from SE13 by this route consistently takes 75 to 90 minutes. A pre-booked minicab from your front door in Lewisham reaches the same terminal in 45 to 60 minutes with no connections and a fixed fare.

mainEntity.name: How long does the drive from Lewisham SE13 to Heathrow Airport take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The drive from Lewisham SE13 to Heathrow typically takes between 45 and 60 minutes. The most efficient route heads west along the South Circular A205 through Catford, Sydenham, and Dulwich before joining the A3 and A316 corridor northwest toward the M3 and M25 approach into the airport. Drivers check live conditions before departure and select the most fluid westbound approach on the day. Early morning runs ahead of the South Circular build-up regularly complete toward the lower end of that range.

mainEntity.name: Do you cover Hither Green as well as the Lewisham town centre area of SE13?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we cover all addresses across SE13 including both the Lewisham town centre area and the Hither Green neighbourhood to the south. Hither Green station, Manor Lane, Hither Green Lane, Beacon Road, and all residential streets in the southern part of the postcode are covered at the same fixed fare as addresses closer to the town centre. Our drivers are familiar with the quieter residential streets around Hither Green and the routes between the two railway stations within SE13, so pickups from any part of the postcode are handled reliably at any hour.

mainEntity.name: Do you cover all streets in SE13 including Ladywell and the Ravensbourne area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we cover all roads across SE13 including Lewisham High Street, Ladywell Road, Algernon Road, Ravensbourne Road, Lewisham Way, Loampit Vale, Loampit Hill, Lee High Road, Manor Lane, Hither Green Lane, Beacon Road, Torridon Road, Brownhill Road, and all residential streets throughout Lewisham town centre, Ladywell, and Hither Green. Our drivers are familiar with the one-way sections around the town centre and the routes near both Lewisham and Hither Green stations, so pickups from any SE13 address are handled reliably at any hour.

mainEntity.name: How far is Gatwick Airport from Lewisham SE13, and do you cover that route?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gatwick is approximately 25 miles south of Lewisham SE13, typically a 40 to 60 minute journey by minicab via the A21 south through Bromley, then the M25 and M23 to the airport. Fixed-fare transfers to Gatwick from SE13 are available for all vehicle classes. Gatwick is somewhat more straightforward to reach from south-east London via the A21 and M25 south than from north or west London postcodes, and every Gatwick fare is confirmed before you travel with no changes on the day.

mainEntity.name: How close is London City Airport to Lewisham SE13?

acceptedAnswer.text: London City Airport is approximately 9 miles northeast of Lewisham SE13, making it the closest major airport by road. A fixed-fare transfer from SE13 to LCY is available for all vehicle classes and typically takes 20 to 35 minutes via the A2 and A1020 route. London City handles European business routes and domestic connections with a single compact terminal, shorter check-in times, and security queues consistently faster than Heathrow or Gatwick.

mainEntity.name: Can I book a return minicab from Heathrow to Lewisham SE13 with meet and greet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the return journey from Heathrow to Lewisham SE13 is available for all vehicle classes with meet and greet included as standard. Your driver will be at the designated meeting point inside the terminal before you clear arrivals, with your flight tracked from departure at its origin. The return fare from Heathrow to SE13 is fixed at £66 for a saloon, confirmed at the time of booking. Forty-five minutes of complimentary waiting time is included with every arrivals booking.

mainEntity.name: What is the best vehicle for a business traveller flying from Lewisham SE13?

acceptedAnswer.text: For solo and dual business travellers, the Executive saloon in a Mercedes E Class or similar provides a premium cabin, reliable luggage space, and a confirmed fixed fare. The Executive can be pre-booked for both outbound and return journeys to Heathrow and London City Airport from SE13. For corporate groups of up to seven passengers, the Executive MPV 7 in a Mercedes V Class combines full capacity with a premium interior and a professional driver. Every executive fare is shown in full at the booking stage with no additions charged at the terminal or on return.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I book a minicab from Lewisham SE13 for an early morning flight?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pre-booking at least 48 hours before your required pickup time is the most reliable approach from Lewisham SE13, particularly for departures before 5am. For larger vehicle classes such as the Executive MPV 7 or the eight-seat MPV, booking 48 to 72 hours in advance gives the greatest certainty of availability and driver allocation. Same-day bookings are possible subject to driver availability at the time of enquiry.
